snippet.title: Hold Your King - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The silence of the kingdom has been broken. The Hold Your King Demo is now available on Steam! 👑

In this physics-based co-op platformer, you and a friend must carry your short-tempered king through deadly medieval courses. Dodge traps, maintain balance, and work together to reach the throne room. One wrong step, and the king might crown you with his rage!

This is an exciting moment! Thank you for all your love and support so far!
We will keep moving forward and strive to live up to the expectations of every player!

👉 Play the free demo & wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564340/Hold_Your_King/

Hold Your King is a physics-based co-op platformer set in a stylized medieval world full of parkours, dangers, and coordination. Trust your friend and carry the king to the throne room.

DON'T LOSE YOUR BALANCE
Beware the physics while carrying the King! Your speed, acceleration, and angular momentum directly affect his balance. Every step you take decides the King’s fate—and therefore yours.

MAKE USE OF YOUR LIMBS
Keeping the King balanced is up to you! Lift the stretcher up or down, rotate it left or right, and use physics to your advantage.

BONK THE KING
Bonk the King to steady him—but he might get angry. Do it at your own risk!

DO NOT ANGER THE KING
Or be ready for whips and tantrums.

HOLD YOUR KING
Pick up the King and drag him back onto the stretcher. Simple? Think again.

USE THE STRETCHER TO CLEAR YOUR PATH
Use the stretcher to interact with dynamic obstacles and clear your path!

#HoldYourKing #Steam #SteamNextFest #Coop
